heading: Chiranjeevi reveals his character name in ‘Kaaka’; Megastar to play Kadiri Kalidas in Bobby Kolli’s film
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Updated: Sep 21, 2026, 12:01 IST
paragraphs: Megastar Chiranjeevi will be next seen in another upcoming Sankranti release ‘Kaaka’ helmed by Bobby Kolli
The film is set to be another action thriller after the duo was last seen in the 2023 film ‘Waltair Veerayya’

There is much anticipation among the fans for more details about the film and the Tollywood veteran has now revealed the name of his character.Chiranjeevi reveals his full name in ‘Kaaka’According to a report by IANS, during a recent event, the actor revealed that he will be seen as Kadiri Kalidas in the film
It is imperative to mention that, the first glimpse of the film released on the Megastar’s birthday showed his name as K
Sathyam working as a supervisor at Ammaji Aqua Industries.The report also suggests that ‘Kaaka’ will be a high-intensity action entertainer with a strong emotional and family-oriented story

Chiranjeevi’s character arc is expected to be one of the important parts of the film.On Thursday, the makers dropped a BTS picture from the sets of the film, where they confirmed that the film is on track to release on its announced date
The post also revealed that the first single of ‘Kaaka’ is set to drop soon.Teaser of ‘Kaaka’Speaking of the teaser, it showed workers from different parts of the country working at the shrimp farm
The video later shows that an employee accidentally drops a key into a pool filled with shrimps
Chirnajeevi retrieves it using a giant electromagnet, however, several weapons also come out along with the key

The keychain carries the words ‘I love dad’.Cast and release details of ‘Kaaka’Speaking of the cast, it features Anaswara Rajan, ‘Kaaka’ features Nivetha Pethuraj, Sunil, Getup Srinu and Kannada actor Rachita Ram in key roles.The film is set for a worldwide release on January 13, 2027, during the Sankranthi 2027 season.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more
